implementation_strategy: Reuse pinned EHR role and central-pipeline source through a generated, ABI-validated game facade and static patch dispatcher. The contracts describe the behavioral boundaries that source reuse must preserve; they do not require rewriting each role in C++.
common_invariants: A role name, source constructor, compiled assembly or export does not prove a working role in the actual game.
All Unity/game-object access occurs on the actual game main thread; background work uses copied immutable data.
Object references retained across callbacks are rooted in their owning managed runtime and released exactly once.
Game IL2CPP objects and NativeAOT managed objects are separate heaps; raw game pointers must never be treated as NativeAOT object references.
Each game target is resolved against actual pinned metadata, native image hash/UUID, full method signature and ARM64 ABI.
Player identity includes round generation and connection incarnation. Death event identity also includes death generation so resurrection/repeated deaths work.
Mutating host behavior requires current host authority and the appropriate lifecycle phase; cancellation semantics are specific to each upstream feature.
Unknown bindings remain unavailable and observable. Returning a successful placeholder is not implementation.

contracts.boundary: Native callback -> typed facade wrappers -> pinned EHR prefix/original/postfix/finalizer dispatcher
required_behavior: Generate explicit factories/roots for RoleBase, IAddon, IGhostRole, IVanillaSettingHolder, IHideAndSeekRole and natural-disaster constructors; preserve upstream enum-to-type mapping and settings registration.

Replace Harmony.PatchAll/runtime Patch calls with an explicit generated registration policy. Preserve class and method attributes, Prepare/Cleanup gates, priority/dependency ordering and duplicate-registration behavior.
Preserve bool-prefix skip semantics, mutable arguments/results, per-invocation __state, postfix result semantics and exception/finalizer behavior. Original-first is insufficient for most EHR patches.
Resolve coroutine MoveNext targets from this game's metadata rather than assuming generated Windows class names or field layouts.
Provide a non-JIT cast/factory path where Expression.Compile, Activator or reflection-based generic construction is not AOT-safe.
Define explicit policies for desktop-only Discord, text input, updater and optional Submerged/LevelImposter integrations; unavailable external modules must not break startup.
acceptance_evidence: Generated registration is compared against pinned callback manifest with explicit unresolved targets
Real callback round trip for primitive, object, ref argument/result, per-call state, struct and exception cases
Actual game startup executes settings and role factory construction without fake game objects

required_behavior: Preserve Main caches, PlayerState, primary role, ordered add-ons, task state, death reason and real-killer records.
Track actual ship/round, authority, intro completion, task phase, meeting and exile rather than a single Started flag.
Port upstream fixed-update/low-load scheduling and LateTask timing through a main-thread scheduler; lifecycle transitions cannot leak delayed actions into another round.
Keep stable facade object identity, Unity destroyed-object/null semantics, collection enumeration and IL2CPP string/array marshaling.
acceptance_evidence: Two consecutive actual rounds reset state
Host loss, reconnect, meeting, exile and revive transitions retain correct identities
Delayed action cannot use collected game objects or a prior-round identity

required_behavior: Execute upstream setup factories to create the effective typed settings registry; the lexical option-site count is not the expanded registry.
Preserve numeric IDs, parent relationships, mode/team visibility, ValueRule index/value conversion, formatting and update/sync events.
Preserve twenty presets, defaults, localization keys and iOS-sandbox persistence; expose actual settings to touch UI rather than another independent list of feature flags.
Snapshot schema/values for reproducible comparisons, including loop-generated and StartSetup/AutoSetupOption IDs.
acceptance_evidence: Expanded ID/default/range/parent registry is compared to pinned upstream execution
Preset edit/save/reload works in iOS sandbox
Settings changes affect the actual role pipeline and vanilla client settings

required_behavior: Preserve upstream host start coroutine sequencing, quotas, chances, exclusions, add-on selection, initializers and role instance creation.
Represent base-role projection as (seer,target) rather than one global role per player. Preserve host and vanilla-recipient desynchronized base roles.
Preserve assignment, intro, task assignment and settings send ordering plus recipient NetId/client routing.
Do not expose secret role identity to other recipients while presenting role descriptions to the intended player.
acceptance_evidence: Actual host plus two vanilla clients receive intended base-role projections
Automatic selected-role/add-on assignment replaces manual ID configuration
Next round role allocation resets without leaking prior roles

required_behavior: Preserve upstream option construction and modifier ordering, role options, add-on interactions, speed inversion/freeze, light/sabotage state, cooldowns and dirty/coalesced sends.
Serialize actual current-game NormalGameOptionsV12/HideNSeekGameOptionsV12 and route to the correct client. Confirm this game's layout/signatures rather than serializing a source-only placeholder.
Preserve the scoped behavior of AURoleOptions static backing state so building one recipient's options does not contaminate the next recipient.
Restore normal settings after temporary effects, death/meeting, disconnect and role changes as upstream specifies.
acceptance_evidence: Flash speed and Watcher votes differ for intended vanilla recipient
Torch vision updates across actual light sabotage and restoration
Two recipients with conflicting options do not inherit each other's values

required_behavior: Intercept actual CmdCheckMurder/CheckMurder before the original. Preserve current authority, phase, distance/rate checks, game-mode dispatch, global role veto/protect/redirect order, target role checks, cooldowns and actual result flags.
Preserve MurderPlayer prefix/postfix and __state; distinguish rejected/protected interactions from confirmed deaths, suicides and delayed or redirected kills.
Update real killer/death reason and global/role murder callbacks once per actual event, with repeated deaths after resurrection supported.
Port report validation and emergency/null-body handling, queued reports, blocked reporting, role exceptions and forced meetings before claiming full Bait parity.
acceptance_evidence: Real vanilla-client kill request can be rejected without original kill
Protected/redirected attacks set correct state/cooldown and do not schedule Bait
Actual automatic Bait report works for other-client killer and configured delays
Meeting/report lock and revive/repeated-death cases match upstream

required_behavior: Preserve PlayerId struct ABI, player/skip/no-vote semantics, role vetoes, vote weights, swaps, overrule/guess/chat commands, ties and tally ordering.
Run report/meeting start/end callbacks and queued meeting deaths in upstream order.
Handle base exile and Airship coroutine completion once, then run WrapUpPostfix/WrapUpFinalizer with actual exiled data.
acceptance_evidence: Actual host and vanilla voters agree on weighted/swapped result
Tie/skip/no-vote handling and meeting death queues match upstream
Airship and ordinary exile callbacks produce one transition

required_behavior: Preserve normal/custom winner priorities, team/id/role winners and additional winner accumulation, source interactions and game-mode end predicates.
Do not suppress the normal game's end checks unless the replacement path can finish successfully.
Project winners to vanilla ghost roles, resynchronize alive/dead data and complete upstream staged end-game sequence rather than setting an internal winner enum only.
acceptance_evidence: Jester exile produces correct actual vanilla win/lose screens
Executioner and additional-winner interactions resolve in source order
Task, sabotage, parity and mode-specific endings complete and return to lobby

required_behavior: Provide actual vent, pet, shapeshift, vanish, sabotage, tasks, positions, teleport, collider and map-system access used by the pinned source, including appropriate pre-original veto points.
Preserve vector/value-type ABI and coroutine scheduling; Unity objects allocated by a role must be actual game objects with safe lifecycle handling.
Run each custom mode through its own assignment, kill/report, timer, HUD/options and win branches; enum presence does not enable a mode.
acceptance_evidence: Ability origin from actual vanilla pet/vent/role RPC causes correct visible effect
Timers and temporary effects reset across map/meeting/round transitions
Each of eighteen selectable modes has an explicit actual-game scenario result

required_behavior: Provide actual Unity text/button/UI object access or equivalent iOS touch settings UI backed by the real registry; preserve role ability affordances for the host.
Preserve per-recipient name/chat/role-description projection and throttling; custom EHR RPC alone cannot render UI for vanilla players.
Preserve intended role secrecy, names, titles, notifications, sounds and localization without leaking temporary display overrides to permanent player identity.
acceptance_evidence: Host changes actual settings using touch
Only intended vanilla recipient sees private role text
Ability use and state changes update actual game UI and clear temporary text correctly

feature_batches.name: Generated source bootstrap and ABI dispatch
feature_batches.bounded_deliverable: Reuse the compiled upstream source with generated role factories/AOT roots and actual typed game facade. Produce a resolved/unresolved patch target manifest and demonstrate dispatch semantics in the actual game; no role-count completion credit yet.

feature_batches.name: Host settings, automatic assignment and recipient options
feature_batches.bounded_deliverable: Select real settings on phone, assign add-ons automatically and observe targeted speed/vote/vision effects on vanilla clients, including freeze/light restoration interactions. These scenarios exercise central code outside their small role files.

feature_batches.name: Kill/report pipeline and complete Bait behavior
feature_batches.bounded_deliverable: Preserve upstream pre-kill checks and MurderPlayer state, validate a rejected/protected attack and a real delayed Bait report. Retire the manual-only Bait implementation once actual upstream pipeline parity is observed.

feature_batches.name: Meeting, exile and end-game source pipelines
feature_batches.bounded_deliverable: Validate actual vanilla voting and winner screens plus ordinary/Airship exile and next-lobby transition; setting only CustomWinnerHolder does not complete this batch.

feature_batches.name: Abilities, tasks, map effects and remaining role interactions
feature_batches.bounded_deliverable: Bind remaining actually referenced game members and validate each dependency family and interaction through reused upstream role code; maintain a mechanics/evidence matrix rather than marking every role complete because it compiles.

feature_batches.name: Alternative modes, presentation and platform completion
feature_batches.bounded_deliverable: Exercise each of the seventeen nonstandard modes separately, localization/settings presets and host touch controls on the physical phone. Record concrete platform substitutes or unavailable external-map integrations instead of claiming desktop-only modules are running.
